descriptions.text: Penelope. Level 5 Yorkshire Sow. This is a pig. Oink, oink. Warning: This beast is magically protected by Taranis. As such, if this beast dies or is even hurt, the culprit will be marked for death by the thunder god. This is Penelope. Again, she is a pig. She is married to both Nico and Dario, and she loves them both equally. At least that's what Nico and Dario believe. No, she didn't used to be a beautiful princess who was transformed by a witch. She's a pig and has always been a pig. Penelope did, however, once get hit by a stray spell. The Touch of Maw-Loo. Also known as the Snowdrop Curse. There was going to be this whole succubus storyline that also involved Emberus and Hellik and Taranis and a bunch of angry spouses on the seventh floor we didn't get to use, so we brought Penelope here. And now when certain NPCs see this fine pig, they fall helplessly in love with her. That includes Taranis, who has it bad for her. Kill her at your own peril.

beats.headline: The pig on the back of One Fine Pig
beats.text: Encountered mid-hailstorm, standing in the road beside team One Fine Pig's vehicle. Two tigrans, Nico and Dario, and the third of their throuple, who is a pig. Examined, catalogued, and flagged with the heaviest warning I hand out anywhere on this floor: a thunder god has taken an interest in her, and anyone who harms her is marked for death by him. That single clause turns a farm animal into the most dangerous object on the road, which I would like on record before anybody gets clever.

beats.headline: Every squeal, a lightning strike
beats.text: Inside One Fine Pig's armoured vehicle, with Crawler Carl punching the door, Penelope squeals. Each time she does, the sky flashes and lightning cracks, louder each time, from a clear day. Crawler Carl notices. The Tigrans decide she is safest in the truck. The plan is to win and get Penny to the safe place. She is the important one, they say.

beats.headline: A plan built around not touching her
beats.text: Crawler Carl works out how to take the tigrans off the board without so much as bruising the pig, and Crawler Donut holds their attention in the wrong direction while he sets the traps for it. The entire design of the thing is a constraint: whatever happens here, nobody lays a finger on Penelope. I have watched a great many plans on this course. That is the constraint every one of them should have been built around, and this is the only one that was.

beats.headline: Removed from the garage of One Fine Pig
beats.text: The garage of One Fine Pig, entered without invitation, and Penelope leaves it in the company of Carl and Donut. Ownership of a pig is not a category I keep records in, so I will put it plainly. The sow has changed hands. The thunder god's protection has not changed at all. Every crawler now sharing a vehicle with her is standing inside the blast radius of somebody else's affection, and I have said as much to anyone who would listen.

beats.headline: Carl feeds a pet biscuit to a pig
beats.text: In the arena, with the floor boss already in sight and the stand-ins being slaughtered on the dirt, Crawler Carl fed an enriched pet biscuit to a pig. Penelope is now a crawler. Penelope is now a member of the Royal Court of Princess Donut. I want it on the record that I read the warning attached to this beast out in full, more than once, and that nothing in it covered the possibility of somebody recruiting her.

beats.headline: The warning holds
beats.text: Deep in the boss fight. Crawler Donut swaps herself with Penelope using one of Lucia's traps, the pig teleports in beside Khepri and picks up the temporary invulnerability, and when Emberus swings at Carl it is the pig who takes it, on account of a Four-Leaf Clover Patch. Then Emberus comes out through Scolopendra's side, and Taranis, who has been in love with this animal since a storyline we never ran, settles the matter personally. Whatever else has gone wrong in this arena, my warning held to the letter.
